label: Asynchronous swap
summary: Defer settlement or fulfillment while preserving explicit liabilities, claims and user exits.
requiredFacts: Which swap leg is deferred and what backs every outstanding claim
Liability namespace, partial-fill rule, expiry, cancellation and withdrawal ordering
Fulfiller or auction authority, competition and failure isolation
requiredTests: Solvency and conservation under arbitrary operation sequences
Partial fill, expiry, cancellation and duplicate fulfillment
Claims, dust, withdrawal ordering and cross-pool isolation
risks: Users can be trapped if cancellation or exit depends on a keeper
Standard routers may not support the interaction
